nodeMissing.title: This card is no longer on the board
nodeMissing.body: The director card was removed or the project changed elsewhere. Go back to the canvas to continue.

sceneMissing.title: This scene is not here
sceneMissing.body: Director "{{title}}" points at a scene this project no longer holds. Stage an empty scene to continue, or go back.

capability.title: This environment cannot draw 3D
capability.body: The director desk needs WebGL, and this browser or desktop view did not provide a WebGL context.
capability.lowTexture: This device's largest texture is {{size}} px; large model textures may be slow.

view.fallback: The shot's camera could not be used; the free view is in use.

contextLost.title: The 3D display context was lost
contextLost.body: The browser reclaimed the graphics context. Wait for it to come back, or rebuild the viewport. Your scene is safe.

environment.failed: The panorama could not be loaded; the background colour is in use.

cameras.lastOne: A scene keeps at least one camera

reference.title: Plates wired in
reference.note: Pictures wired into this desk wait here. Nothing enters the scene until you choose it.
reference.noAsset: This node has no usable asset
reference.empty: No upstream pictures are wired to this desk

cardPanel.title: Shot card
cardPanel.assetMissing: The asset is not in this project
cardPanel.apertureNote: Aperture and focus distance go into the prompt; they do not change the preview depth of field.
cardPanel.promptHint: Your own words come first in the compiled prompt.
cardPanel.nothing: Select an object, camera, or light in the viewport.
cardPanel.bonePriority: Keyframes decide a bone first; a static override stands over the pose. A pose clears overrides and the active clip.

rig.title: Skeleton mapping
rig.unmapped: Only {{count}} joints mapped. Choose the missing ones below.

cardPanel.useAsPerformer: Use this model as a performer
cardPanel.compiledPromptHint: Fixed in the interface language when delivered; editing the scene does not rewrite a delivered snapshot.
cardPanel.promptCopied: The lens direction is on the clipboard.
cardPanel.copyFailed: The browser would not copy automatically; select the text above and copy it.

save.conflictBanner: The project changed in another window. Editing is frozen until it is reloaded.
save.frozen: The project changed elsewhere; reload before editing.

deliver.title: Deliver shot
deliver.intro: Save the active shot of “{{scene}}” as a project asset and write it to this director card. The shot is “{{shot}}”.
deliver.blockingUnsupported: This environment cannot record a video, so only the frame can be delivered. {{reason}}
deliver.blockingUnavailable: This environment cannot record a video (MediaRecorder or canvas.captureStream is unavailable), so only the frame can be delivered.
deliver.transcode: Transcode the blocking reference to MP4
deliver.transcodeHint: The server's ffmpeg turns the WebM recording into an MP4. Without ffmpeg the WebM is kept and said so.
deliver.controlNote: Control passes are saved to the asset shelf only; the card's frame output is left as it is.
deliver.exported: Exported the “{{mode}}” frame of “{{shot}}” to the asset shelf.
deliver.doneFrame: The shot frame was written to this director card.
deliver.doneBlocking: The blocking reference was written to this director card.
deliver.noContext: The viewport is not ready to draw a frame yet.
deliver.noShot: This scene has no active shot.
deliver.stale: The scene or shot changed while delivering, so nothing was written.
deliver.staleDetail: The active shot is now “{{shot}}” at {{time}}s. Try again.
deliver.frameFailed: The shot frame could not be captured.
deliver.recordFailed: The blocking reference could not be recorded.
deliver.uploadFailed: The delivered file could not be uploaded.
deliver.transcodeFailed: The blocking reference could not be converted to MP4; the WebM recording was kept.
deliver.ffmpegMissing: ffmpeg was not found, so the blocking reference was kept as WebM.
deliver.assetsKept: Uploaded files remain on the shelf; the director card was not changed.
deliver.tagsFailed: The asset's tags could not be written

exit.errorTitle: The scene could not be saved
exit.body: Your changes are still here. You can stay, retry the save, or reload the latest project.

dock.label: Viewport tools
dock.card: Show or hide the shot card

blocking.title: Blocking
blocking.pending: The motion timeline arrives with the motion tools.

addActor.title: Add an actor
addActor.body: Choose an actor from the Actors page of the board. The six humanoid and two quadruped starting points all use real metre sizes.

placeActor.title: Place the actor
placeActor.body: Select the actor and tap the ground to move them there. Other objects keep their distance automatically.

poseActor.title: Pose the actor
poseActor.body: Switch to Perform and choose a pose, or adjust the body in the shot card.

recordKeys.title: Record keyframes
recordKeys.body: In Motion, set the playhead and record the actor's position and the camera's move.

checkFrame.title: Check the frame
checkFrame.body: Switch to Lens and look through CAM. The shot's frame and camera decide what is delivered.

recordBlocking.title: Record a blocking reference
recordBlocking.body: Record the shot as a blockout video and keep it beside the frame.

deliver.title: Deliver the frame
deliver.body: Deliver the shot to the card, then wire its frame, blocking reference, and lens direction into a video node.

models.unsupported: .{{ext}} is not a format this desk reads; export a GLB from the modelling tool.
models.exportGlb: Only GLB or self-contained GLTF is supported. Export GLB from the modelling tool.
models.uploaded: Added "{{name}}" to the shelf and the stage.
models.uploadFailed: The model could not be uploaded.
